name: Collateral Cancellation Status 2
definition: Provides details on the status (that is accept or reject) of the CollateralManagementCancellationRequest message.

CollateralStatusCode.name: Collateral Status Code
CollateralStatusCode.definition: Allows to provide a cancellation status using a code or a proprietary status.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information on the status of the CollateralManagementCancellationRequest message.

RejectionDetails.name: Rejection Details
RejectionDetails.definition: Provides rejection reason and optionaly additional information.

StatusRejectionReasonRule.definition: If Collateral StatusCode equals Rejected then RejectionDetails must be present.
